calls.reason: The GPT-3 paper records coherence lapses but also high overall text quality, and Scarecrow finds GPT-3 text remarkably fluent. No measurement of GPT-3 memorization from the period is supplied, so the picture is mixed.
In BIG-bench the best models scored under 20 against experts near 100, but PaLM beat the average human on aggregate. Neither study measures distance from general language understanding.
